note: The script asks for four graphics: the hook text, Amber's name super, the 15 minutes number pop and the 988 text card, then MHA's end card. The warm-line number on the end card is still owed (Nick confirms it with MHA), and MHA has no logo file, so the end card types the words.

mg.title: Hook text
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1, big and bold, top third: Someone will pick up. Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on. Off at 00:03.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:03, over the ringing phone. Top third.

mg.title: Amber name super
mg.cue: Name super at 00:05, 3 s, lower left above the captions: Amber Pendley · Director of Operations, MHA Nebraska. Once only.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:05 when Amber first appears and hold it 3 seconds. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line Director of Operations, MHA Nebraska under it.

mg.title: 15 minutes
mg.cue: Number pop on “up to 15 minutes” (about 00:09), top third, 2 s: 15 minutes
mg.use: Put it on as Amber says “up to 15 minutes” (about 00:09), over Madison's call. Top third, 2 seconds. Keep captions on.

mg.title: 988 text card
mg.cue: Text card, once: In crisis? Call or text 988. Cut to it on “the 988 number” and hold it to the end of the row.
mg.use: Full-screen card, used once. Cut to it on “the 988 number” (about 00:29.5) and hold it until the cut at 00:32. Captions stay on. 988 appears here only.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: End card, 5 s, MHA colors: If you're struggling, call this number. Under it the Keya House warm-line number, once Nick confirms it with MHA. Never 988 here.
mg.src: MHA Nebraska has not sent a logo file (never rebuild one), so the end card is the script's words in MHA's colours (endcards/index.json, 22 Oct 2026).

text.name: MHA Nebraska
lines: If you're struggling, call this number.

mg.use: This is the end card. Put it at 00:38 after “It was nice talking to you.” and hold it 5 seconds. Type the Keya House warm-line number under the line once Nick confirms it with MHA. Never 988 here, never a number from Google.
